Bartenders by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Bartenders have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $58,180 in Seattle, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Seattle $58,180, Chicago $31,200, Austin $23,670.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
